tips.text: Get two Adarza imprints from a friend instead of rerolling incubations; players regret burning codes chasing a breed.
Build and install the Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment before buying imprints; without it the incubator shows only Kubrow breeding.
Gamble on a random incubation if you have no imprints; Adarza is the breed most players are trying to avoid.
Expect the Kavat Genetic Code farm to be the whole grind; it is a top least-favorite farm, and the rest is credits and timers.
